nivel.label: Level
nivel.tooltip: The hierarchy level determines the role's priority. A higher level indicates greater authority (e.g.: 100 = Admin, 10 = Operator).

help.nombreRol: Unique name identifying the role in the system (e.g.: Administrator, Pharmacist, Cashier).

help.nivelJerarquia: Number representing the role hierarchy. Higher number = greater authority. E.g.: Admin = 100, Supervisor = 50, Operator = 10.
